checks.name: Static RTL review
checks.result: Combinational continuous assignments, exact benchmark ports and widths, three ternary 2-to-1 muxes and one constant output; no other logic operators, storage, clocks or resets. Each of the three distinct nonconstant output functions requires a mux, so three muxes are minimal.

development_outcome: Initial candidate passed independent exhaustive development simulation without RTL revisions. candidate_initial.sv was preserved before development checks. RTL: candidate.sv; testbench: dev_tb.sv. Outputs are combinational with no pipeline or sequential latency; constants and data operands are one bit.
limitations: Official evaluation was not accessed and its results are unknown.
No synthesis, Vivado timing/resource evidence or board testing was performed.
Development simulation covers binary input combinations.
